Services are delivered through in-person and administrative labor, subject to contractual agreements with external clients.

products.name: Investor Relations and Public Relations Services
products.description: Provision of investor relations and public relations services to external healthcare companies, delivered through professional consulting and communications expertise, under multi-year service agreements with fixed fees and equity-based compensation.

products.name: Neurology Therapeutics
products.description: Development and commercialization of novel, disease-modifying therapies for neurological disorders, focusing on assets with strong biological rationale and clinical data. These are typically small molecule or biologic drugs requiring extensive preclinical and clinical development, regulatory approval, and manufacturing under cGMP standards.

products.name: Oncology Therapeutics
products.description: Development and commercialization of innovative therapies for cancer, including targeted therapies, immunotherapies, and precision medicine approaches. These products require drug discovery, clinical trials, regulatory approval, and manufacturing, and are delivered as pharmaceutical products to healthcare providers.

products.name: Out-Licensing of Legacy Oncology Assets (TPI 287 and Berubicin)
products.description: Out-licensing of investigational chemotherapy agents (TPI 287 and Berubicin) originally developed for central nervous system cancers such as glioblastoma. These assets are offered to external partners for further development and commercialization, leveraging existing clinical data and intellectual property.

products.name: Module Level Power Electronics (MLPEs)
products.description: Manufactured hardware devices installed under solar panels that provide power optimization, rapid shutdown, and module-level monitoring for residential, commercial, and utility-scale solar systems. Delivered as physical products compatible with most inverters and modules, often bundled with software tools for monitoring and diagnostics.

products.name: Energy Storage Solutions (GO ESS)
products.description: Integrated hardware systems for residential solar energy storage, including batteries, hybrid inverters, automatic transfer switches, and EV chargers. These systems provide backup power, optimize home energy consumption, and are managed via a mobile app and browser-based platform.

products.name: Energy Intelligence (EI) Software Platform
products.description: Cloud-based software platform that provides advanced energy monitoring, system diagnosis, over-the-air software upgrades, and module-level analytics for solar installations. Delivered digitally and used by installers and system owners for real-time and historical performance data.

products.name: Premium Monitoring Services
products.description: Subscription-based software services offering enhanced data granularity and extended historical data storage for solar system monitoring, available for an additional annual fee beyond the standard platform.

products.name: Predict+ Energy Demand Forecasting Software
products.description: Software as a Service (SaaS) solution leveraging AI and machine learning to provide customizable forecasting models for electricity generation and consumption, targeted at utilities, independent power producers, and grid planners. Delivered digitally with APIs and data connectors for integration.

products.name: Corporate Debt Investments
products.description: The company primarily provides loans and invests in corporate debt securities, including first and second lien secured loans, senior unsecured debt, subordinated debt, convertible debt, and related instruments to small to large private U.S. companies. These investments are originated, underwritten, and monitored by a team of investment professionals and require significant financial capital and regulatory compliance as a business development company.

products.name: Collateralized Loan Obligation (CLO) Investments
products.description: The company invests in CLO structured credit funds, including CLO equity and junior debt tranches, which are structured finance vehicles that pool diversified portfolios of senior secured loans. These investments are managed through both primary and secondary market transactions and require specialized expertise in structured credit analysis and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Other Structured Credit and Fixed Income Investments
products.description: To a lesser extent, the company invests in other structured credit products such as collateralized debt obligations (CDOs), asset-backed securities, corporate bonds, municipal bonds, and convertible securities. These are acquired as part of a diversified investment strategy and may include both cash and synthetic instruments, requiring financial capital and expertise in credit markets.

products.name: Equity Investments and Warrants
products.description: The company may receive or purchase equity securities, such as common equity, preferred equity, convertible preferred equity, and warrants, typically in connection with its debt investments. These are generally ancillary to the core lending business and are acquired as part of the overall investment package to enhance returns.

products.name: LivePerson Platform (Digital Customer Conversation Platform)
products.description: A cloud-based, enterprise-class SaaS platform that enables brands to orchestrate and manage AI-powered and human-assisted customer conversations across digital channels (web, mobile, SMS, social media, voice) with integrated analytics, automation, and security features. Delivered as a hosted, multi-tenant solution requiring no on-premise infrastructure.

products.name: Conversational AI and Automation Solutions
products.description: AI-powered tools and automation capabilities, including generative AI, bots, and large language models, that automate customer interactions, provide agent assistance, and enable self-service across messaging and voice channels. Delivered digitally via the LivePerson Platform.

products.name: Conversational Intelligence and Analytics
products.description: Dashboards, reporting, and analytics tools that analyze conversational data from customer interactions to provide actionable business insights, measure performance, and optimize customer engagement strategies. Delivered as part of the platform’s digital suite.

products.name: Conversation Builder and Manager Tools
products.description: Software tools for designing, managing, and optimizing automated and human-assisted conversations, including workflow builders, agent consoles, and sentiment monitoring. Delivered digitally through the platform for use by contact center staff and administrators.

products.name: Syntrix Simulation and Evaluation Platform
products.description: A simulation and evaluation platform that allows enterprises to test, validate, and optimize AI agent behavior and human agent readiness before deployment to real customers. Delivered digitally as a SaaS solution.

products.name: Professional Services (LP 360)
products.description: Consulting and optimization services provided by domain experts to help customers implement, customize, and maximize the value of LivePerson products, including deployment support, performance analysis, conversational design, training, and ongoing management. Delivered through in-person and remote human expertise.

products.name: MyoVista wavECG Device
products.description: A proprietary 12-lead resting ECG medical device that incorporates both conventional ECG analysis and HeartSciences’ proprietary AI-ECG algorithms to detect cardiac dysfunction, including diastolic and systolic dysfunction. The device requires physical manufacturing, proprietary hardware, embedded software, and consumable electrodes for each test.

products.name: MyoVista Insights Cloud Platform
products.description: A cloud-based, device-agnostic ECG management and analytics platform designed to host, deliver, and manage AI-ECG algorithms (developed internally or by third parties), provide centralized ECG storage, and integrate with clinical workflows. Delivered as a digital SaaS solution, it enables algorithm access from existing ECG devices without hardware replacement.

products.name: AI-ECG Algorithms for Cardiac Disease Detection
products.description: A suite of proprietary and licensed artificial intelligence-based algorithms designed to analyze ECG data for detection of various cardiac conditions (e.g., impaired cardiac relaxation, low ejection fraction, aortic stenosis), delivered via the MyoVista wavECG device or the MyoVista Insights Cloud Platform. These are digital-only products requiring regulatory clearance and are monetized through usage or subscription models.

products.name: Proprietary ECG Electrodes and Consumables
products.description: Single-use, proprietary electrodes and related consumables required for each test performed with the MyoVista wavECG device. These are physical products manufactured to work exclusively with the company’s hardware, supporting a recurring 'razor-razorblade' revenue model.

products.name: Middle-Market Debt Investments
products.description: Provision of debt capital to U.S. middle-market companies, primarily through senior secured first lien, unitranche, second lien, and subordinated loans. These loans are originated or acquired and are secured by company assets or structured as unsecured, with investments typically held to maturity. Delivery requires significant financial capital, underwriting, and ongoing portfolio management.

products.name: Equity Investments in Portfolio Companies
products.description: Minority equity investments in the form of common stock, preferred stock, and warrants, typically made alongside debt investments in middle-market companies. These investments are structured to provide potential capital appreciation and may include rights such as registration or put options. Delivery involves financial capital and legal structuring expertise.

products.name: Structured Finance Securities Investments
products.description: Investments in structured finance securities, primarily mezzanine and subordinated notes of CLOs and loan accumulation facilities. These are financial products representing interests in portfolios of below-investment-grade loans, requiring specialized expertise in structured credit and risk management. Delivery is through capital deployment and ongoing monitoring.

products.name: Broadly Syndicated Loan Investments
products.description: Acquisition of broadly syndicated loans, which are large, leveraged loans originated and structured by banks for large corporate borrowers and distributed to institutional investors. These are typically purchased on the secondary market and require financial capital and expertise in loan syndication and credit analysis.

products.name: Natural Gas Transportation and Storage Services
products.description: Provides transportation and storage of natural gas through an extensive network of intrastate and interstate pipelines and storage facilities, regulated by FERC and state agencies. Services are delivered via long-term contracts and fee-based arrangements to utilities, industrial end-users, power generators, and other pipelines.

products.name: Natural Gas Midstream Services
products.description: Offers gathering, compression, treating, dehydration, blending, and processing of natural gas from wellhead to market, utilizing a network of pipelines, processing plants, and treating facilities in major U.S. basins. Services are provided to producers and are integrated with transportation and storage assets.

products.name: NGL (Natural Gas Liquids) Transportation, Fractionation, Storage, and Marketing
products.description: Transports, stores, fractionates, and markets NGLs (ethane, propane, butane, natural gasoline, ethylene) via pipelines, fractionation facilities, and storage terminals. Includes export capabilities and blending services, delivered through dedicated and take-or-pay contracts to domestic and international customers.

products.name: Refined Products Transportation, Storage, and Marketing
products.description: Provides transportation, storage, and marketing of refined petroleum products (gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, heating oil) through pipelines and terminals across the U.S., including blending and export services. Delivered via fee-based contracts to wholesalers, retailers, and commercial customers.

products.name: Crude Oil Transportation, Storage, and Marketing
products.description: Transports, stores, and markets crude oil via an integrated network of pipelines, gathering systems, terminals, and trucking assets. Services include acquisition at the wellhead, storage, and delivery to refineries and trading hubs, provided under tariff and marketing agreements.

products.name: LNG Regasification Services
products.description: Operates an LNG import terminal and regasification facility, providing storage and regasification of liquefied natural gas for delivery into the natural gas pipeline system, under long-term contracts with major energy companies.

products.name: Wholesale Fuel Distribution and Retail Marketing (via Sunoco LP)
products.description: Distributes motor fuels and other petroleum products to retail stores, dealers, distributors, and commercial customers across North America, Europe, and the Caribbean. Includes operation of retail convenience stores and branded fuel supply, leveraging a large logistics and terminal network.

products.name: Refining of Petroleum Products (via Sunoco LP)
products.description: Operates petroleum refineries that process crude oil and bio-feedstocks into gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, and other products, supplying both retail and commercial customers. Production meets regulatory requirements for low-carbon fuels.

products.name: Natural Gas Compression Services (via USAC)
products.description: Provides compression services for natural gas and crude oil production, processing, and transportation, using a fleet of compression units deployed under fixed-fee contracts to producers and midstream operators.

products.name: Transmix Processing Services (via Sunoco LP)
products.description: Processes transmix (off-specification mixtures of refined products) at dedicated facilities to separate and return merchantable gasoline and distillates, supporting fuel distribution and third-party customers.

products.name: Coal and Natural Resources Management and Royalties
products.description: Manages and leases coal and natural resource properties, collecting royalties and providing land management services, including timber sales and leasing of coal-related infrastructure to industrial customers.

products.name: Acoramidis (Attruby/Beyonttra)
products.description: Acoramidis is a next-generation, orally administered small molecule transthyretin (TTR) stabilizer for the treatment of transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy (ATTR-CM). It is manufactured via third-party contract manufacturing organizations and delivered as an oral medication, commercialized directly by BridgeBio in the US and through partners internationally.

products.name: Fosdenopterin (Nulibry)
products.description: Fosdenopterin is an intravenous formulation of synthetic cyclic pyranopterin monophosphate, developed as a treatment for molybdenum cofactor deficiency (MoCD) Type A. It is manufactured and commercialized by a partner (Sentynl Therapeutics) and is delivered via intravenous infusion.

products.name: Infigratinib-based Therapies for FGFR-driven Skeletal Dysplasias
products.description: Infigratinib is an orally administered, selective FGFR1-3 tyrosine kinase inhibitor developed for the treatment of achondroplasia and hypochondroplasia, both genetic skeletal dysplasias. It is produced via chemical synthesis and delivered as an oral sprinkle capsule, with ongoing late-stage clinical development and planned commercialization.

products.name: Encaleret-based Therapies for Calcium Homeostasis Disorders
products.description: Encaleret is an investigational, orally administered small molecule negative allosteric modulator of the calcium sensing receptor (CaSR), developed for the treatment of autosomal dominant hypocalcemia type 1 (ADH1) and chronic hypoparathyroidism (CHP). It is produced via chemical synthesis and delivered as an oral medication, with late-stage clinical development and planned commercialization.

products.name: BBP-418 for Limb-Girdle Muscular Dystrophy Type 2I/R9 (LGMD2I/R9)
products.description: BBP-418 is an orally administered, small molecule therapy developed for the treatment of LGMD2I/R9, a rare inherited neuromuscular disorder. It is produced via chemical synthesis and delivered as an oral medication, currently in late-stage clinical development with plans for global commercialization.

products.name: Gene Therapy for Canavan Disease (BBP-812)
products.description: BBP-812 is an investigational intravenous gene therapy using AAV9 vector technology for the treatment of Canavan disease, an ultra-rare neurodegenerative disorder. It is delivered via intravenous infusion and is in early-stage clinical development.

products.name: Truseltiq (infigratinib) for Cholangiocarcinoma (withdrawn)
products.description: Truseltiq is a selective FGFR inhibitor that was approved for the treatment of cholangiocarcinoma with FGFR2 fusion or rearrangement. It was manufactured via chemical synthesis and delivered as an oral medication, but is no longer commercially available after withdrawal of approval.

products.name: Next-generation ATTR-CM Depleter Therapy (Evanesco)
products.description: A preclinical monoclonal antibody therapy designed to selectively bind and promote clearance of misfolded, amyloidogenic TTR in patients with transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy (ATTR-CM). It is intended for intravenous administration and is in preclinical development.

products.name: Pay-TV Services
products.description: Provision of pay-TV services under the DISH and SLING brands, including satellite-based DISH TV and internet-based SLING TV, delivered via owned/leased satellites, broadcast operations, and streaming platforms. Includes equipment leasing, installation, and digital content delivery.

products.name: Wireless Communication Services
products.description: Provision of nationwide wireless communication services to consumers, primarily under the Boost Mobile and Gen Mobile brands, including voice, text, and data plans, device sales, and value-added services. Delivered via a hybrid MNO/MVNO model using owned network core and partner networks.

products.name: Broadband Internet Services
products.description: Provision of broadband satellite internet services to consumer customers (homes and small businesses), using owned satellites and ground infrastructure, with installation and equipment provided. Focuses on unserved and underserved markets in the Americas.

products.name: Enterprise and Government Network Solutions
products.description: Provision of broadband network technologies, managed services, equipment, hardware, and satellite communications solutions to enterprise and government customers. Includes design, development, and installation of telecommunication networks, satellite ground segment systems, and terminals.

products.name: In-Flight Connectivity Solutions
products.description: Provision of integrated, multi-transport solutions enabling airlines and airline service providers to deliver in-flight network connectivity for commercial and business aviation, using satellite and ground network technologies.

products.name: Satellite Technology and Equipment Sales
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of satellite gateway and terminal equipment, as well as satellite ground segment systems, to other satellite system operators and enterprise customers. Includes both in-house assembly and outsourced manufacturing.

products.name: Third-Party Broadcast Operations and Services
products.description: Provision of digital broadcast operations, including satellite uplinking/downlinking, transmission, and related services to third-party pay-TV providers, leveraging owned broadcast infrastructure and expertise.

products.name: Installation and Support Services for Satellite and Wireless Customers
products.description: Provision of installation and in-home services for satellite and wireless customers, including equipment setup and customer support, as well as installation and other services for new Starlink customers under commercial agreements.
